name: Toolbar
description: A horizontal action bar with grouped controls and hairline separators.

anatomy.description: The role="toolbar" container holding all groups.
A role="group" cluster of related controls within the bar.
A decorative hairline between groups, hidden from assistive technology.

dos: Group related controls with ToolbarGroup and separate clusters with ToolbarSeparator.
Label every icon-only control with IconButton's label prop.
Keep the bar to one row of compact controls that act on one view.
donts: Don't put page-level commit actions here; use an ActionBar.
Don't use a toolbar as a general layout row.
Don't nest toolbars inside each other.

examples.title: Editor actions
examples.description: role="toolbar" with groups keeps related controls navigable.

examples.title: Formatting groups
examples.description: Group related controls and separate them with hairlines.

guidance.useWhen: Several small controls act on one editor or view.
guidance.avoidWhen: The actions are unrelated page actions; use a header action area.
guidance.behavior: role="toolbar" groups controls; separators are decorative hairlines.
guidance.responsive: Let groups wrap or scroll horizontally on narrow screens.

notes: Renders role="toolbar" so assistive technology announces the grouped controls as one toolbar.
ToolbarGroup uses role="group" to keep related controls together in the accessibility tree.
ToolbarSeparator is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
Keyboard behavior comes from the controls inside; label icon buttons with IconButton's label prop.

apiEntries.description:
A horizontal container for related actions, such as editor controls.
Compose with `ToolbarGroup` and `ToolbarSeparator`.
Groups related controls inside a Toolbar.
Vertical hairline that visually separates toolbar groups.
